# ND Blocking & Previs 0.1.3 Beta

A small patch release fixing the in-app update download action.

### Fixed

- Download Update now opens the latest macOS release ZIP in the default
  browser.
- Added clearer error feedback if the external download cannot be opened.

### Platform

- Web: https://blocking.duongtruongdp.net/
- macOS Apple Silicon / arm64 Beta

Windows remains pending real build validation and is not included in this
release.
